annotations.title: Identify and verify one HTTP request

description: Identifies whether a request comes from an AI agent, which one, what kind (training, AI search, user-triggered, agentic browser…) and whether its identity is verified or spoofed, using what each operator publishes (IP lists, reverse DNS, Web Bot Auth signatures; see https://knocklog.ai/agents). Pass the client IP, the full request URL and all request headers for the most complete check.

ip.description: Client IP as seen by the server

method.description: HTTP method of the request (default GET)

user_agent.description: The User-Agent header of the request, exactly as received

name: classify_request
title: Identify and verify one HTTP request
